question: In what time (in years) will ₹2,800 fetch an interest of ₹700 at 5% per year simple interest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Calculate interest as a percentage of the **Principal**: (700 ÷ 2800) × 100 = 25%.

Since the **Rate** is 5% per year, the **Time** required is: 25% ÷ 5% = 5 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2,800

Interest (I) = ₹700

Rate (R) = 5% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f28ffa8b4fcb28db901fe241092dbe7b397002c944c21d5cdc3780d1ad412d4.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ T = (700 × 100) ÷ (2800 × 5)

⇒ T = 70,000 ÷ 14,000

⇒ T = 70 ÷ 14

⇒ T = 5 years

**∴ The correct answer is 5 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

The basic formula for **Simple Interest** is SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, where P is Principal, R is Rate per annum, and T is Time in years.

Total Amount

The **Total Amount** (A) after T years is the sum of Principal and Interest: A = P + SI = P × [1 + (R × T) ÷ 100].

Interest and Time Relationship

For a fixed **Principal** and **Rate**, **Simple Interest** is directly proportional to **Time**. If time doubles, interest also doubles.
